children.game_version: A rhythm game where children learn to click bamboo in time with a song.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the bamboo clicking while seated in a circle.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the clicking without complex footwork.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to match the comfort of the group.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Dancers hold bamboo strips in their hands and strike them together
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two rows facing each other or a circle

signature_moves.description: Striking bamboo strips together to produce a rhythmic sound.
signature_moves.name: Bamboo clicking

music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by the contrast between the melodic a cappella singing of older women and the sharp, percussive clicking of bamboo strips held by the young dancers.
music_profile.vocal_style: A capella singing by a choir of older women

basic_steps: Form two rows or a circle
Strike bamboo strips together in rhythm
teaching.formation: Two rows facing each other or a circle
